cases.name: local_opaque_mask
cases.source:
#include <stdint.h>
void test(void) { register uint8_t data asm("r17"), mask asm("r18") = 0x80; asm volatile("" : "=r"(data), "+r"(mask)); data ^= mask; asm volatile("" : "+r"(data)); }
